name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.40.0: the screen-layout flags now actually reach the machine. Chasing posters not appearing on kiosks: the posters themselves were never the problem - ads arrives in the config correctly, with url, type and durationSec, and the dashboard's upload path is sound (R2 upload, then PUT /ads, then touchConfig). What was missing is the flag that says the poster region is switched on. showAdRegion, showLeftHero, showRightHero, showIdleScreen and idleTimeoutSeconds were all stored, all editable in the dashboard, all accepted by the settings endpoint, and none of them were in buildConfigResponse - so the poster-area toggle was a control with nothing on the other end, the same shape of fault as defaultLanguage in v6.38. All five are now served, defaulting to the DEFAULT_SETTINGS values so a machine that was never configured behaves as the dashboard shows it. Verified both directions against a running backend. Health also now reports imageHosting: whether R2 is configured and which public host it serves from. The existing imaging field only says whether sharp loaded, so it can read ok while no poster can be stored at all, and the public host is worth seeing because it is the URL the kiosk must fetch over TLS - a custom domain there has broken machines before. No secrets, and the host is already inside every poster URL. Whether this fixes the reported symptom depends on the app actually reading these flags, which the kiosk team needs to confirm. Cumulative over v6.39.1.
